name: Sinew Lab
description: The Sinew fitness brand. Warm lab paper and charcoal ink, Tibi cobalt as the brand colour, marigold spark for emphasis, coral muscle red reserved for anatomy, emerald for evidence; Outfit display over Inter, JetBrains Mono for sources and data.

tokens.texture: Flat vector with a soft dot grid on diagram plates; no grain on the character.
tokens.spacing: --u = 1% of short side; character scale from Studio.kit.fitness.tibi({scale})

motion.personality: Friendly and precise: springy character acting, calm diagram builds
motion.notes: The mascot never freezes (idle breathing, blinks, reps); diagrams build in steps with drawn lines.

contrast_checked: emerald #12a36e/paper 2.9:1 and marigold #ffb224/paper 1.6:1 (shapes only, never text); ink on marigold 9.3:1
suitable_for: anatomy and physiology with a mascot

validation.evidence: Contrast ratios computed from the stylesheet hex values (WCAG 2.x formula), 2026-11-08. Used by projects/how-muscles-grow.
